instruction: A candid full-shot photograph from an eye-level angle shows an indoor martial arts studio with wooden walls and a black mat. On the right, the martial artist in the black gi (R1) is crouching, facing left, and holding the arm of the partner. On the left, the martial artist in the pink gi (R2) is sitting on the mat, facing right, leaning back with legs bent. The martial artist in the black gi (R1) maintains a firm grip on the arm of the martial artist in the pink gi (R2) as they practice a technique. The scene is illuminated by warm indoor lighting with natural tones.
